answer: Jetty Timing Ledger. Each new agent identity must publish its first N outbound messages from a distinct network vantage with inter-message gaps drawn from a saffron-marked secret distribution; verifiers sample arrival spacing and reject identities whose gaps are too uniform or too fast. Honest agents naturally jitter; cloned fleets emit correlated, low-variance timing that costs an attacker real elapsed wall-clock time per identity plus distinct hosting, sharply capping spawn rate. Each identity also needs one nectar-seeded challenge response.
